name: AIToolHunt
conditions: Free launch requires adding the AIToolHunt badge/link to your homepage ('Free with badge verification').
Free listings are reviewed and listed within 30 days — a long queue relative to peers.
requirements: AI tools; profile pages carry categories, tags, FAQ content, related tools, and your website link.
Account required — /submit redirects to a login page (email/password plus Google and GitHub OAuth).
Directory advertises DR 40+ on Ahrefs for its outbound links.
preparation: Badge/link to aitoolhunt.co placed on your homepage if using the free plan.
Product name, URL, description, category, tags, and FAQ content for the SEO-friendly profile.
Plan choice: Free (badge, ~30 days) / Basic $15 instant / Pro $39 featured 15 days / Sponsor $79 for 15-day homepage showcase.
workflow: Open https://aitoolhunt.co/submit — log in or register first.
Free: keep the homepage badge live; expect review within 30 days. Paid plans: instant publishing after checkout verification.
watchFor: Submit is behind a login wall — the form is not visible until you register.
The 30-day free review window is much slower than paid 'instant publishing'.
Pro/Sponsor prices shown struck-through ($39/$195, $79/$395) — promotional framing.
Sponsor's 'complimentary Guest Post' is explicitly not guaranteed.
Site provides its own DR checker and 'Agent Readiness' tools — upsell-adjacent features, not requirements.
countsAsLive: A public product page at aitoolhunt.co/item/<slug> reachable while logged out and listed under Recently published / categories.
unknowns: Whether the free-tier badge is re-checked after publication and what removal triggers.
Whether the struck-through prices ever apply.
